DARV.talk.GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CHARACTER_CH: Ah... a visitor from beyond. Your shadow arrived before you.
I did not tell it your name.
You had better not have either.
This book was blank a moment ago. You entered, and it gained a page.
Or is something deeper looking at me through your eyes?
NEOW.talk.GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CHARACTER_CH: No. The number has not changed.
But each time, the place you return to is farther from here...
The thing beyond the door has heard your heartbeat...
NONUPEIPE.talk.GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CHARACT: The voice that answered for you has not stopped.
Do not answer that voice. It will carry on speaking with yours.
No one here knows where you came from.
...Nor does anyone know the thing following you.
When you speak its name, your voice turns into shadow.
There is a noise about you that does not belong here.
It weaves stars within your thoughts.
OROBAS.talk.GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CHARACTER_: Have you come to claim what is yours?
How strange! How strange! These things all say they once belonged to you.
Quickly! Quickly! Hold out your hand. The other one!
I have seen the shape you once had!
I have also seen the shape you are going to lose!
PAEL.talk.GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CHARACTER_CH: I dislike discussing one matter with two people.
A being like you has been here before.
If you hear a song ahead calling your name,
pretend it is not your name.
TANX.talk.GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CHARACTER_CH: Hey, stranger! Did your shadow just blink?
...Stay still. It fell on the floor. Why is your hand still catching it?
Hey, just one customer’s price today.
If the one behind you asks, tell it I saw nothing.
TEZCATARA.talk.GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CHARACT: Your passage has left no omens.
The candlelight of fate seems to sink into the void.
The void... perhaps it is the void...
You carry unfinished chains of cause and effect.
They devour one another behind your back.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CHA: I suppose I did not leave an entrance for every visitor.
I seek a way to escape the shackles of the void.
Where you stand, the design calls for a wall.
You should use the front door.
I do not welcome uninvited guests.
You say you are escaping control.
My thoughts tell me to escape the fate of being consumed in return.
Then who made you stop here and hear the rest of this sentence?
VAKUU.talk.GUEST_FROM_HERESY_CHARACTER_C: Look up. Let me see what is lodging behind those eyes.
...I did not ask you to look up as well.
Aha. Something lives inside your body.
